experiments.scope: Matched-scale grouped birthday: 32 groups x 32 m15 (N_t=2^10) on exact 2-round root compression via m15 partial evaluation. 20-bit digest-xor-mask on o0/o1/o2 low bits with N_t^2/2^w=1, matching full-scale N^2/2^256=1. Digests only from partial evaluator; organizer re-verifies. Parameters fixed before production runs.
experiments.hypothesis: Under H1-grouped-digests, masked collision detection frequency is near the random-model coverage 1-exp(-1/2)≈0.393 at this matched scale, supporting that multi-group structured prefixes do not grossly suppress masked collisions for the truncated 2-round map.

experiments.scope: Structured stress: one group, m15=0..255 (N_t=2^8), 16-bit mask on o3/o4 low bytes. Same partial evaluator. Within-group pairs only — the most dependent layout. N_t^2/2^w=1 matched scaling holds formally for the mask event. (Reduced from 1x1024/20-bit to fit the organizer's 20s Docker timeout.)
experiments.hypothesis: Even the single-group layout yields masked-collision detections; any material depression relative to 0.393 is disclosed as a limitation of H1 for highly structured sets (within-group pairs are a 2^-96 fraction of full-scale pairs).

experiments.scope: Smaller matched scale: 16 groups x 16 m15 (N_t=2^8), 16-bit mask, N_t^2/2^w=1. Same algorithm/evaluator. Cross-scale consistency check for EXP-EXT against the 2^10 b3r2-grouped-spread (the former 2^12 64x64 scale was dropped for the 20s Docker timeout).
experiments.hypothesis: Masked coverage frequency remains near 1-exp(-1/2) at this smaller matched scale under H1.

experiments.scope: Word-metered SWAR evaluator (4 lanes x 64-bit slots per 256-bit word) on 32 groups x 32 m15 (N_t=2^10), same 20-bit o0/o1/o2 mask as b3r2-grouped-spread. Word meter sampled once/trial (straight-line body); birthday digests use a plain-int twin. Counts body Word ops with 256-bit rotation charged ROT_COST=3 (shr+shl+or); fused FF+pack K=(A|(B<<32))^rot(C|(D<<32),128) expected 101 ops. Checks digest bit-equality vs an inlined 2-round root compress identical to verifier/blake3.py, and K_full equals the declared bit-permutation of that digest, on a sample: the metered message, the first 8 messages of group 0, and both messages of any returned pair (not every message, to fit the 20s Docker timeout). Flat numeric observations only. Host recomputes digests for returned pairs; observation counts are untrusted labels.
experiments.hypothesis: Under H-COST-SWAR-EVAL the SWAR body costs exactly 101 Word ops per message with bit-exact digests and K_full on every reference-checked message at ROT_COST=3, and masked birthday detections remain near 1-exp(-1/2) at matched scale.
